samples.question: The image holds four independent, independently-noised exposures of the same faint two-tone symbol, multiplexed into one field at the column level: column j belongs to exposure j mod 4, so no exposure is ever contiguous and the symbol is invisible in direct view. De-interleave the four exposures by their column phase and average them element-wise; the shared symbol bias accumulates while the independent noise averages away. Which symbol is revealed, the filled circle (A) or the filled square (B)? Answer A or B.
